I now have all the navigation data. Let me compile the complete picture.

Here is the exact navigation structure extracted from `boldteq-v1-0.webflow/index.html` (lines 125–390):

---

## Navigation items in order (as they appear in the HTML)

### Top bar (above the navbar)
- **Banner**: "🚀 We're upgrading the website experience — Some sections may update in real-time."
- **Banner CTA**: `Join Beta` → `javascript:void(0);` (triggers `#bt-popup-trigger` beta popup)

---

### Logo
- `Boldteq logo` → `index.html` (class `nav-23-logo`, `aria-current="page"`)

---

### Main nav links (inside `<nav role="navigation" class="nav-23-menu">`, inside `<div class="nav-23-links">`)

| # | Label | Type | href |
|---|-------|------|------|
| 1 | **Solutions** | Dropdown | — |
| 2 | **How It Works** | Direct link | `how-it-works.html` |
| 3 | **Pricing** | Direct link | `pricing.html` |
| 4 | **Our Work** | Direct link | `our-works.html` |
| 5 | **Our Mission** | Direct link | `our-mission.html` |
| 6 | **Resources** | Dropdown | — |

---

### Solutions dropdown items (in order)

| # | Label | href | State |
|---|-------|------|-------|
| 1 | **Web Development** | `services/website-development.html` | Active |
| 2 | **UI/UX Design** *(Coming Soon badge)* | `#` | Disabled |
| 3 | **Graphic Design** *(Coming Soon badge)* | `#` | Disabled |
| 4 | **App Development** *(Coming Soon badge)* | `#` | Disabled |

Plus a bottom card at footer of the dropdown:
- Text: "Can't find what you are looking for?" + "Boldteq will tailor a solution…"
- CTA link: **"View Full Service Scope"** → `scope.html` (class `sky-button`)

---

### Resources dropdown items (in order)

| # | Label | href |
|---|-------|------|
| 1 | **Blog** | `blog.html` |
| 2 | **Help Center** | `https://help.boldteq.com/` |

---

### Right-side CTA buttons (inside `<div class="nav-23-right">`, hidden on mobile)

| # | Label | href |
|---|-------|------|
| 1 | **Login** | `https://portal.boldteq.com/` (class `button-secondary-large`) |
| 2 | **Schedule Demo** | `book-a-demo.html` (class `btn-primary`) |

Mobile: hamburger burger menu button (lines 380–386), no mobile-specific links shown in this section.

---

## Answers to your specific questions

1. **"How It Works" in the nav?** — YES. It is the 2nd item in the main nav, a direct link to `how-it-works.html`, immediately after the Solutions dropdown.

2. **All nav items in order**: Solutions (dropdown) → How It Works → Pricing → Our Work → Our Mission → Resources (dropdown)

3. **Solutions dropdown**: Web Development (active) + UI/UX Design (Coming Soon) + Graphic Design (Coming Soon) + App Development (Coming Soon) + "View Full Service Scope" footer link

4. **Resources dropdown**: Blog + Help Center

5. **CTA buttons**: Login (`https://portal.boldteq.com/`) + Schedule Demo (`/book-a-demo`) — both hidden on mobile via `hide-mobile` class
